summary: Third retest completed. Backend iter331 P0 regression and OperationCard V5 static test pass, but authenticated live Operations UI on preview still renders 0 V5 cards because same-origin /api requests are repeatedly aborted in browser automation.

ui_bugs.issue: Authenticated mobile run still shows `operations-active-tab-count` = `0 عملية` and no `[data-testid^='operation-card-v5-main-']` cards; first-card toggle/menu/detail checks are blocked.

integration_issues.issue: Browser log shows repeated `net::ERR_ABORTED` on same-origin APIs including `/api/operations?limit=200` and `/api/accounts`, resulting in empty operations UI despite backend endpoint being healthy.

action_items: Investigate preview-edge/browser network abort source for same-origin `/api/*` calls during authenticated Operations load.

After abort issue is fixed, rerun required live checks: first-card additional info toggle, full-details toggle (customer items/supplier items/payment history/accounting treatment), more-actions menu actions, and collection button presence/state.
Keep payment safety constraint: inspect collection button only, do not execute settlement/payment in retest.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/src/pages/Operations.jsx` remains very large and mixes many concerns (data loading, filtering, forms, rendering), increasing regression risk and making runtime fetch failures harder to isolate quickly.
Render-time fallback loop appears removed as expected, but live behavior remains blocked by browser-level API aborts outside card component logic.

success_rate.frontend: 55% (login + static V5 + mobile overflow passed; live V5 card interactions blocked by zero rendered cards)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Used public URL from frontend/.env and manager credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Reproduced zero-cards state again at mobile widths. Overflow checks at 320/390/430 show no horizontal overflow. Console log confirms repeated same-origin API aborts (`/api/operations`, `/api/accounts`, and others), while backend probe test confirms `/api/operations` returns non-empty array.
rca of the issue: Repro: login as manager -> open /operations -> `operations-active-tab-count` stays `0 عملية` and no V5 cards render. Browser automation log consistently records `net::ERR_ABORTED` for same-origin `/api/*` requests. Backend regression and direct operations probe pass, so issue likely lies in preview browser/edge request lifecycle rather than OperationCard V5 JSX or backend business logic.
